page_title: RMA 1-0 OSA | Real Madrid v Osasuna 19/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' A VAR review has confirmed the red card for Abel Bretones (Osasuna).

90+5' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Abel Bretones (Osasuna), but referee Adrian Cordero must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+4' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) can have an early bath after being sent off by the referee for a tackle that simply has no place in football!
90+2' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Arda Guler walks off the pitch to be replaced by Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid).
90' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.

90' A pass travels right across the box to Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper inside the left post, but Sergio Herrera denies him with a decent save.
85' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) meets a cross inside the box and heads it goalwards. Unfortunately for him, he sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a chance!
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Raul Garcia (Osasuna) comes onto the pitch so that Juan Cruz can be given a rest.
84' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
83' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle after Ante Budimir (Osasuna) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
82' Some patient build-up play from Real Madrid as they look to unlock the defence.
79' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
78' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) replaces Vinicius Junior.
77' The substitution has been made. Moi Gomez (Osasuna) has replaced Aimar Oroz.
76' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
74' The corner is swung in and Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the left post from close in.
74' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
73' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
73' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
71' The attendance for today's match is 68407.
70' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
69' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
68' Today's match ends for Brahim Diaz who will be replaced by Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid).
68' Xabi Alonso decides to make a substitution. Trent Alexander-Arnold will be replaced by Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid).
68' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
66' Adrian Cordero interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid).
66' Substitution. Ruben Garcia did his best and is replaced by Victor Munoz (Osasuna).
65' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
63' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
62' The possession of the ball – 71:29.
59' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
58' The resulting corner from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) is cleared by the defence.
57' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
55' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Thibaut Courtois intercepts the ball.
51' Referee Adrian Cordero halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Alessio Lisci, then shows him a yellow.
51' Goal! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Sergio Herrera to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
51' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
50' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. A penalty is given to Real Madrid!
50' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
49' The ball is cleared after Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
47' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) sends a long ball in, but Thibaut Courtois comfortably gathers the ball.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
43' Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
42' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
40' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post.
38' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
37' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
37' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) is penalised for holding. Adrian Cordero signals a set piece. A free kick to Real Madrid.
34' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the right post.
31' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
28' The free kick is taken by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna), but ball is cleared.
28' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul. Osasuna are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
27' Real Madrid work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
26' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) receives an accurate pass and finds some space for a shot. The keeper is prepared and denies his long-range effort towards the left post. Brilliant save!
26' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Sergio Herrera is alert and denies him.
24' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
21' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is penalised for a foul. Adrian Cordero had a clear view and blows his whistle.
19' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

18' Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) latches onto a pass and lets rip with a swerving shot from long range towards the bottom right corner. It's a difficult effort to deal with and Sergio Herrera does well to punch it away.
15' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
12' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
10' Real Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

10' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
9' The Real Madrid players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
7' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
4' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
3' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.

Real Madrid will kick the game off.
Adrian Cordero will referee today's match.
